crossRefs.note: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
“Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?
“Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?
Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

translations.web: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

translations.kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
translations.asv: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,
